nli.note: Generic bidirectional NLI; not the specialized published MIS model. No equivalence threshold calibrated.

academic_style.reason: No calibrated independent academic/non-academic classifier supplied. Revision intent labels and formality classifiers are not academic-style labels.

fluency.note: No calibrated grammar/fluency model or external causal LM has been provided. Generator CE is not independent perplexity.

limitations: Similarity and NLI can reward copying. Style gain and human review are separate requirements.
NLI probabilities are not guarantees for negation, numbers, citations, technical terms or hedging.
No automatic or human success rate is inferred from incomplete dimensions.
This test set was inspected; use fresh held-out material for confirmatory evaluation.
